services.intro: Keep the site and tools you already use. Begin with a guided intake, then add only the work that proves useful.

items.title: Smart Intake
items.description: Guided, trade-specific intake on your existing website. Capture service details, photos, location, and clear next steps in one structured opportunity.

items.title: Lead Rescue
items.description: Follow up on quiet inquiries and missed calls on a schedule you set, in your words, stopping the moment a customer replies.

items.title: Custom software
items.description: Engineering for the work no module covers: internal tools, spreadsheet digitization, data cleanup, and integrations.

approach.title: Build from a real lead, not a product pitch.
approach.description: We start with an inquiry that came through your door and look for the smallest useful improvement.

steps.title: Measure what changed
steps.description: Review lead completeness, response speed, estimate readiness, and repetitive office work removed.
